title: mklang run/resume result
description: Wire shape returned by host.build_output() and extended by CLI/MCP surfaces. Documented for outer hosts (scripts, MCP clients, orchestrators). Not part of the language contract (SPEC); additive fields may appear on surfaces. Schema version is the top-level `schema_version` when present; absent means the pre-1.1 implicit shape (status/error/result/usage/trace[/at[/checkpoint…]]).

schema_version.description: Optional document version for hosts that pin contracts. Current published value: "1". Omitted by today's CLI/MCP emitters; hosts should treat absence as version 1 of this shape.

status.description: done = completed; halt = aborted (gate fail, budget without checkpoint, tool/call failure, …); suspended = resumable (budget or escalate under checkpoint/HITL); error = MCP/domain prep failure payload (not an engine RunResult).

error.description: Null on done. On halt/suspended: reason string (e.g. budget-exhausted, escalated, gate-fail, output-truncated, call-failed). On MCP error payloads: short code or message.

result.description: Machine result value (context key from machine.result, or last state output). Null/omitted semantics follow the engine when the run did not finish cleanly.

limits.description: Applied step/token limits and cumulative usage for the run.

trace.description: Ordered step records (state, gates, nested sub_trace for call:). Empty array when none.

at.description: State id where a halt/suspend occurred, when known.

ask.description: On an escalate suspension (0.4): the gate's authored ask, literal — safe to display where machine output is untrusted.

reply_to.description: On an escalate suspension (0.4): context key path the reply lands at on resume (default human.reply).

diagnosis.description: On budget-exhausted / cost-exhausted: which state ate the run. Present only when a state was entered more than once.

checkpoint.description: CLI: filesystem path written on suspend. MCP: opaque single-use session handle (and optionally checkpoint_file for the durable path).

checkpoint_file.description: MCP only: durable checkpoint path when checkpoint_path was requested in addition to the in-memory handle.

warnings.description: MCP (and some hosts): non-fatal prepare/load warnings.

truncated.description: Present on compact agent observations (console) when produce truncation was detected (ADR 0018).

result_truncated.description: Present on compact observations when the result string was clipped for the brain.
